clue.text: Bill joins a spy organisation as a plant

parts.note: AC is short for account, and a bill is an account owed
the CIA is the US intelligence agency

explanation.surface: A man named Bill goes undercover in a spy agency as a mole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plant' in the surface sense is a secret agent placed inside, but here it is the tree or shrub.
explanation.definitionFit: The acacia is a flowering tree or shrub, so it is an example of a plant.

clue.text: A friend one may make much of

indicators.note: making something out of the word means rearranging its letters to form a new one

explanation.surface: A friend is someone you make a fuss of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make much of' looks like the idiom for fussing over someone; the letters of MUCH are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Chum is an informal word for a close friend.

clue.text: Statesman badly led by the clergy

indicators.note: in a down clue the leading piece comes first, above the next

parts.note: the church as a body means the clergy
ill can mean badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: A politician performs poorly under church guidance.
explanation.walkthrough: Winston Churchill was Britain's wartime Prime Minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Churchill was a famous British statesman and Prime Minister.

clue.text: The man on watch?

parts.note: a man's name that is also a watch chain, named after Prince ..., so the man is literally on the watch

explanation.surface: A guard or lookout keeping watch.
explanation.walkthrough: A pocket-watch chain is called by this name after Queen Victoria's consort.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name doubles as the term for a chain worn with a pocket watch.

clue.text: Book subscription too often renewed

indicators.note: something renewed is made over again, so these letters are put together in a new order

explanation.surface: A magazine subscription that keeps getting renewed far too often.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Renewed' rearranges the eight letters of TOO OFTEN. 'Subscription' is used in its literal sense of something written underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: A note printed below the text on a book's page is literally written under it, a subscription in the old sense.

clue.text: Funeral directors show definite promise

definitions.meaning: a business of undertakers, read as a company that buries

explanation.surface: A firm of undertakers shows real commitment.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a business, it is a company of undertakers; read as a phrase, a firm pledge.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means a binding pledge, and read literally a company in the burial trade.

clue.text: Sort of survey for guns?

definitions.meaning: the ... Survey is Britain's official mapping agency

explanation.surface: A question about what kind of review covers weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ordnance Survey is the UK's national mapping body.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both Britain's mapping survey and artillery or military weapons.

clue.text: Lack of practice for players in group

parts.note: no means none, a lack of something
nets are where cricketers practise batting and bowling

explanation.surface: Players in a team without any training.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket nets are netted practice areas, so NO NET is a lack of practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A nonet is a group of nine musicians playing together.

clue.text: Utterly restricted

parts.note: 'utterly' is read as 'in uttering', so the phrase means limited in speaking

explanation.surface: Something completely limited.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unable to speak freely through shyness is to be restricted in what one utters.

clue.text: Proverbially remains cool, though often framed

definitions.text: Proverbially remains cool, though often framed

parts.words: Proverbially remains cool, though often framed
parts.note: the saying 'cool as a ...' names this vegetable, and gardeners grow it under glass frames; 'framed' also suggests a falsely accused suspect

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm even though they keep being set up for crimes.
explanation.walkthrough: British gardeners grow this salad crop in cold frames, glass boxes over the bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The salad vegetable is the proverbial byword for coolness and is commonly raised in garden frames.

clue.text: Understand about inn being exceptional for eating

indicators.note: one word placed about another goes around it, so the slang word wraps the jumbled letters

parts.note: to dig is slang for to understand

indicators.note: exceptional letters are out of their usual order, so the three letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An exceptional inn is good to understand as a place for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dig' as slang for understand is the key; 'exceptional' in the surface praises the inn, but it signals the jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Dining is the act of having a meal, a synonym for eating.

clue.text: Round trip?

parts.note: read literally, a trip that is round is one that goes in a circle and comes back to its start

explanation.surface: A simple question about a return journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A tour that loops back to its starting point is literally a round trip.

clue.text: No doubt backers of cockfighting had an eye to it

definitions.text: No doubt backers of cockfighting had an eye to it

parts.words: No doubt backers of cockfighting had an eye to it
parts.note: a main was a cockfighting match, so gamblers watched the main contest, and to have an eye to it is to seek one's own advantage

explanation.surface: Gamblers on cockfights were always watching for something.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'main' was a cockfighting contest; having an eye to the main chance means looking after one's own interest.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means one's best opportunity for personal gain, and once a cockfighting match.

clue.text: Vehicle to move before take-off

definitions.meaning: an aircraft rolls along the runway under its own power before it lifts off

explanation.surface: A car moving into position just before departure.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab is a vehicle, and aircraft taxi along the ground before flying.

clue.text: Confer a medal on deck

definitions.meaning: to honour someone with an award
to deck is to adorn or ornament

explanation.surface: A medal pinned on someone standing on the deck of a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deck' looks like part of a ship but is the verb to adorn.
explanation.definitionFit: To decorate is both to award an honour and to adorn, a synonym of deck.

clue.text: An outstanding example of cartography

parts.note: 'outstanding' is read literally as standing out, as hills raised on a moulded chart do

explanation.surface: A superb piece of mapmaking.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart showing hills and valleys in raised form literally has features that stand out.

clue.text: Not yet decided on flying, perhaps

definitions.meaning: airborne, as a plane in flight

explanation.surface: A plan for a flight remains undecided.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means uncertain or unresolved, and literally airborne.

clue.text: By no means a fleet response that may raise a laugh

definitions.text: By no means a fleet response that may raise a laugh

parts.words: By no means a fleet response that may raise a laugh
parts.note: a single ship is by no means a fleet, and a short quip that gets a laugh has the same name

explanation.surface: A witty reply that is far from quick still manages to amuse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fleet' looks like the adjective quick, but it is a group of ships; a lone ship is not one.
explanation.definitionFit: A short joke delivered in a single line is called by this name.

clue.text: The song told a story

definitions.meaning: a German art song, as by Schubert

explanation.surface: A ballad that narrated a tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Told a story' is a euphemism for telling a fib.
explanation.definitionFit: A German art song has this name, and to tell a story can mean to tell an untruth.

clue.text: Four slip out from the revelry, being lustful

indicators.note: slipping out of something is leaving it, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: a carnival is a festival of revelry
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Four revellers sneak off from the party in a lustful mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slip out from' removes IV from CARNIVAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Carnal means relating to bodily or sexual appetites, close to lustful.

clue.text: When fighting men go into the services

definitions.text: When fighting men go into the services

parts.words: When fighting men go into the services
parts.note: 'the services' looks like the armed forces, but means church services that soldiers march to

explanation.surface: The moment soldiers join up with the armed forces.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal march of troops to a religious service is known by this term.

clue.text: Put up a temporary construction ready for drill

definitions.meaning: to equip with a drilling rig, as for oil

explanation.surface: Building a makeshift structure ready for drilling practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drill' suggests military exercise, but here it is drilling for oil with a rig.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to erect something makeshift, and to set up a drilling rig.

clue.text: Ring a girl to come round soon

indicators.note: the name comes round the ring shape, enclosing it

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name
O is shaped like a ring

explanation.surface: Phone a girlfriend and ask her to visit shortly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ring' looks like a phone call but is O; 'to come round' puts ANN around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon is an old word meaning soon or shortly.

clue.text: Variation in game puzzles people

definitions.note: the definition is a phrase for something that baffles, standing for a noun

indicators.note: a variation is a changed version, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new version of a game leaves the players baffled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Variation' rearranges IN GAME; the surface nods to Elgar's Enigma Variations.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle or mystery is something that baffles anyone who meets it.

clue.text: Move west from Wyoming in terrible disgrace

indicators.note: terrible suggests something in a mess, so these letters are jumbled
taking a letter from a word removes it, so the compass letter leaves the state's name

parts.note: to move west is to head W, the compass abbreviation for that direction

explanation.surface: Someone shamed in Wyoming is told to head west.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking W away from WYOMING leaves YOMING; 'terrible' rearranges that with IN.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignominy means public shame or dishonour, a synonym of disgrace.

clue.text: A golfer gets upset about first putt in game

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go about the next piece, surrounding it
something upset is knocked over and disordered, so these letters are rearranged
first means only the opening letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: A golfer is upset about his first putt during a round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' turns A GOLFER into LEAFROG, and 'about' puts P from 'first putt' inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Leapfrog is a children's game of vaulting over each other's backs.

clue.text: Raised in company of wolves

parts.note: a child brought up among wolves, like Romulus and Remus, might be described with the adjective meaning wolf-like

explanation.surface: A child brought up by a wolf pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Lupine means relating to or like a wolf, from the Latin for wolf.
